comment: The base inputs of the image (rules 61 and 62; advisor Oct 12): there is no base image and no image recipe file; apko assembles the image from committed locks.
A change in a file listed here since the latest release is the "base input changed" signal: bin/patch-decide.py classifies a commit that changes only these
(and neutral files) as a fix, and the decide job of release.yml prints them (patch-decide.py base-moved). The names are cache-ce's: the apko base lock of each
variant, the melange lock, the Wolfi archive key and index records, and the fips module record. The recipes (build/apko*.yaml, build/melange*.yaml) declare the
build and are build inputs, not base signals. A path listed here that is not on main yet is the cache lane's to land (known-red entry KR-BASE-LOCKS).
